description: This source file provides implementation of miscellaneous functions related to Wi-Fi management and system operations for a platform, including semaphore handling, system event handling, Wi-Fi configuration, daemonization, and messaging functions.

methods.name: int rdkb_sysevent_open(char * ip,unsigned short port,int version,char * id,unsigned int * token)
methods.description: Opens a system event connection with given IP, port, version, and identifier, returning a token.

methods.name: int rdkb_sysevent_close(const int fd,const unsigned int token)
methods.description: Closes a system event connection identified by file descriptor and token.

methods.name: int rdkb_wifi_enableCSIEngine(int apIndex,mac_address_t sta,bool enable)
methods.description: Enables or disables the CSI Engine on a specified access point index and station MAC address.

methods.name: int rdkb_wifi_getRadioTrafficStats2(int radioIndex,wifi_radioTrafficStats2_t * output_struct)
methods.description: Retrieves radio traffic statistics for a specified radio index.

methods.name: void rdkb_daemonize()
methods.description: Daemonizes the process, sets up semaphores, and redirects standard input/output to /dev/null.

methods.name: void rdkb_sendWebpaMsg(char * serviceName,char * dest,char * trans_id,char * traceParent,char * traceState,char * contentType,char * payload,unsigned int payload_len)
methods.description: Sends a WebPA message with specified parameters.

methods.name: void wifi_misc_init(wifi_misc_t * misc)
methods.description: Initializes the misc structure with function pointers for various Wi-Fi and system operations.
